observations.lesson: Strong evidence that the scanner can observe a regime shift before the explosive phase, but enrichment/actionability latency prevents credit. Do not lower momentum thresholds based on this single unreconciled session; prioritize catalyst and Sharia qualification latency.
Do not award discovery credit where first observation occurs after a large move. Apply Late/Exhaustion logic even when subsequent RVOL remains extreme.
Exclude from actionable universe regardless of momentum. It may remain a non-actionable market-regime observation only if data integrity is later reconciled.
